title: Nvidia scandal: Corporate accountability at stake
description: The controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is no longer merely about personal indiscretion. There are allegations that his affair with a Chinese businesswoman facilitated the transfer of billions of dollars’ worth of restricted AI (artificial intelligence) chips to China. The entire episode raises troubling questions about corporate accountability, national security and the concentration of power in global technology companies. According to media reports, a network of firms operating across China and Southeast Asia helped channel Nvidia processors, including those restricted under US export controls, to Chinese businesses. The alleged shipment of chips worth at least $7.5 billion indicates that sophisticated supply chains can become vulnerable to intermediaries and regulatory loopholes.
